plan_needed: Your school must have Compass AI switched on by its Compass account manager, and your school or education authority must have approved Claude. You need the Compass permissions your school requires for the connector. Any Claude plan: Free allows one custom connector, and Pro and Max users add their own. On Claude Team or Enterprise, an Owner adds the connector first (see claude-team-owner-adds-compass). Compass isn't in Anthropic's Connectors Directory yet, so it's added as a custom connector.

steps.do: Go to Customize > Connectors and click Add custom connector. Compass's page calls this menu Settings › Connectors.
steps.see: The Add custom connector dialog.

steps.do: Paste https://mcp.compass.education/mcp as the server URL, then click Add.
steps.see: Claude opens Compass's school picker.

steps.do: Search for your school by name and select it.
steps.see: The Compass sign-in page.

steps.do: Log in with your normal Compass details.
steps.see: Claude is connected. Compass says the assistant never sees your password. Compass's page doesn't show the approval screen.

steps.do: Click +, choose Connectors and switch Compass on for this conversation.
steps.see: The Compass tools your Compass role allows. Tools your role can't use are hidden.

steps.do: Ask a question, such as what a student has due in the next fortnight. Approve the tool when Claude asks.
steps.see: Read-only answers from Compass. If Compass AI isn't switched on for your school, sign-in works but every tool returns an error.

undo.do: Click Remove, or the three-dot menu next to the Compass connector, and follow the prompts.
undo.see: The connector is removed from your Claude account.

undo.do: Ask your school administrator to remove MCP access from your Compass account.
Ask Compass to revoke your connector access.
undo.see: Compass says it revokes the access token within 5 business days. Data already passed to the AI provider stays under that provider's retention policy.

plan_needed: Claude Team or Enterprise, as an Owner or Primary Owner. On Enterprise, a member whose custom role can manage the organisation's libraries can also do it. Your school must have Compass AI switched on and must have approved Claude.

steps.do: Go to Organization settings > Connectors, select Add, then Custom. If Claude asks for the connector type, choose Web.
steps.see: The Add custom connector dialog.

steps.do: Enter https://mcp.compass.education/mcp as the server URL and click Add.
steps.see: The connector appears for members under Customize > Connectors with the Custom label.

steps.where: Each member's Claude account, Customize > Connectors
steps.do: Each member finds the connector with the Custom label and clicks Connect, then picks the school and signs in to Compass.
steps.see: Each person sees only what their own Compass role allows.

undo.do: Click Remove, or the three-dot menu next to the connector, and follow the prompts.
undo.see: The connector is removed for the organisation.

plan_needed: Gemini Enterprise (Google's guide covers the Standard, Plus, Pay-as-you-go and Frontline editions) and a Google Workspace administrator. Google lists Google Cloud prerequisites first, including an organisation policy override for custom MCP data stores and the Discovery Engine Editor role. The school must have Compass AI switched on and must have approved Gemini. Compass and Google use different menu names, so both are given.

steps.where: Gemini Enterprise admin console (in the Google Cloud console, the Gemini Enterprise page)
steps.do: Sign in as a Workspace administrator.
steps.see: The Gemini Enterprise console.

steps.do: Compass says go to Connectors › Custom MCP server › Add custom MCP server. Google's guide says click Data stores, then Create data store, type Custom MCP Server into Search sources and click Add MCP server.
steps.see: The MCP Server Configuration page.

steps.do: Choose OAuth 2.0 and enter https://mcp.compass.education/mcp as the MCP Server URL. Click Verify Auth, then Continue.
steps.see: Google's form asks for OAuth details such as a client ID. Compass's page doesn't say what to enter, only to confirm the OAuth handshake.

steps.do: Pick your school.
steps.see: Compass says Gemini remembers the school for the whole organisation.

steps.do: Choose a location from the Multi-region list, enter a name in Your data connector name, and click Create.
steps.see: The data store's state changes from Creating to Active.

steps.do: Click Actions > Reload custom actions, select the actions to enable and click Enable actions.
steps.see: Compass's tools become available. Google says no actions are on until you enable them, and each call asks the user to confirm unless the tool is marked read-only.

steps.do: Authorise the connector for the staff groups who should use it.
steps.see: Staff in those groups can ask Gemini about Compass data without adding a connector themselves. Each sees only what their own Compass role allows. The exact screen isn't described in either guide.

undo.do: Not documented by Compass. Google's setup guide doesn't cover deleting a data store.

undo.where: Your school, or email to legal@compass.education
undo.do: Ask your school administrator to remove MCP access, or email Compass to revoke access.
undo.see: Compass says it revokes the access token within 5 business days of an email request.

from: Your own app or a vendor's product
plan_needed: Compass must grant access; use is limited to pre-approved vendors and schools. The person whose API key is used needs the APIAccess permission. Software vendors go through Compass's Approved Integration Partner process, which Compass says may take 3 to 6 months and ends in a pricing assessment for setup and ongoing use. Programming experience needed.

steps.do: Contact Compass Support to request Public API access, naming the school or vendor you represent.
steps.see: Compass processes the request. The response isn't described.

steps.do: Send the integration type, the data you need, your security evidence (such as ISO 27001 certification and hosting location) and how often you'll call the API.
steps.see: Compass confirms receipt, typically within 5 to 7 days, then reviews the application.

steps.do: Find the API key for the person who holds the APIAccess permission.
steps.see: A unique key for that person.

steps.do: Send requests with the key in the CompassApiKey header and Content-Type set to application/json.
steps.see: JSON responses. Compass records API use with personally identifiable information for auditing.
